title: Their Names in Scripture
subtitle: Where the Acts and St. Paul name them
source: Scripture is the King James Version, as the app's Bible carries it, word for word. Rodion is the Herodion of Romans 16:11.

sections.title: Acts 19:22
paragraphs: So he sent into Macedonia two of them that ministered unto him, Timotheus and Erastus; but he himself stayed in Asia for a season.

sections.title: Romans 16:11
paragraphs: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus, which are in the Lord.

sections.title: Romans 16:15
paragraphs: Salute Philologus, and Julia, Nereus, and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints which are with them.

sections.title: Romans 16:21-23
paragraphs: Timotheus my workfellow, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen, salute you. I Tertius, who wrote this epistle, salute you in the Lord. Gaius mine host, and of the whole church, saluteth you. Erastus the chamberlain of the city saluteth you, and Quartus a brother.

sections.title: 2 Timothy 4:20
paragraphs: Erastus abode at Corinth: but Trophimus have I left at Miletum sick.
